result.summary: The page is mostly usable, but there are a few visual/content polish issues: horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge, one discount badge shows a nonsensical “-0%”, and truncated restaurant naming looks unfinished.

issues.description: The rightmost cards/chips are visibly cut off at the screen edge, especially the “Trattoria Piccol…” restaurant card and the category chip sliver after “Healthy”.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding/margin to horizontal scroll containers or use peek spacing that clearly indicates more items without clipping text mid-word.

issues.description: A promo badge on the lower popular item reads “-0%”, which is meaningless and looks like a formatting/data error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is zero or format valid discounts only, e.g. “-10%”.

issues.description: Restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol…” is truncated abruptly in the fastest-near-you carousel.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, reduce card density, or widen cards so merchant names remain readable.
